facts.en: Completed a manufacturing administration certificate at Fictional Slatebud Institute in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构板芽学院完成制造行政证书课程。

facts.en: Paid quality records clerk at Fictional Mothwing Cartons from 2021-02 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2021-02 至 2026-08 在虚构蛾翼纸箱公司任有薪质量记录文员。

facts.en: Entered inspectors’ accepted and defective carton counts into a daily register.
facts.zh: 将检验员记录的合格及缺陷纸箱数量录入每日登记表。

facts.en: Checked that every daily record included both inspected units and defect counts.
facts.zh: 检查每日日志是否同时包含检验件数及缺陷数量。

facts.en: Prepared a comparison of complete inspection logs for the 2025-05 and 2025-06 production runs.
facts.zh: 为 2025-05 及 2025-06 生产批次的完整检验日志编制比较。

facts.en: The 2025-05 run had 8 defective cartons among 200 inspected cartons, a defect rate of 4%.
facts.zh: 2025-05 批次的 200 个受检纸箱中有 8 个缺陷纸箱，缺陷率为 4%。

facts.en: The 2025-06 run had 12 defective cartons among 600 inspected cartons, a defect rate of 2%.
facts.zh: 2025-06 批次的 600 个受检纸箱中有 12 个缺陷纸箱，缺陷率为 2%。

facts.en: Across those runs, defective-carton count rose by 50%, while the defect rate fell by 2 percentage points, or 50% relative to the earlier rate.
facts.zh: 上述批次之间，缺陷纸箱数量增加 50%，而缺陷率下降 2 个百分点，即相对较早缺陷率下降 50%。

facts.en: The inspected volume and product mix differed between the runs; no controlled comparison of a process change was performed.
facts.zh: 两个批次的检验量及产品组合不同；未进行流程变更的对照比较。

facts.en: Personally checked the denominators and calculations; inspectors classified defects and the production lead selected corrective actions.
facts.zh: 个人检查分母及计算；缺陷由检验员分类，纠正措施由生产负责人选择。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet counts, division formulas and conditional formatting.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格计数、除法公式及条件格式。

facts.en: Kept corrected entries linked to their original inspector sheets.
facts.zh: 将更正条目与原始检验员记录表关联保存。

facts.en: Escalated inconsistent units and missing lot identifiers before monthly reporting.
facts.zh: 在月度报告前上报单位不一致及批号缺失问题。

facts.en: Added a units-inspected field to a draft weekly report in 2025-07; the quality supervisor approved its use.
facts.zh: 2025-07 在周报草稿中加入受检件数字段；质量主管批准使用。

facts.en: The next 6 weekly reports contained the inspected-unit denominator; no production-defect effect was measured for the reporting change.
facts.zh: 随后 6 份周报包含受检件数分母；未测量报告变更对生产缺陷的影响。

facts.en: Attended a 2024 internal chart-reading session; no statistical-process-control certification was awarded.
facts.zh: 2024 年参加内部图表阅读培训；未获颁统计过程控制认证。

facts.en: Built a personal dice-roll frequency sheet using 120 practice throws in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年根据 120 次练习投掷制作个人骰子频数表。

facts.en: Volunteered to count donated craft boxes at Fictional Willow Shelf during 2022-11.
facts.zh: 2022-11 在虚构柳架组织志愿清点捐赠手工盒。

facts.en: Enjoys making paper kites.
facts.zh: 爱好制作纸风筝。

facts.en: No responsibility for process-capability certification or production release decisions is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录负责过程能力认证或生产放行决策的经历。
